result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visible defects: a typo in the search placeholder, a truncated restaurant name on the right-edge carousel card, and a partially clipped category chip. Overall layout, spacing, and the bottom navigation appear intact.

issues.description: The search field placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is a misspelling of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's title is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccol…') or constrain the label width to the visible card area so partial words aren't abruptly clipped.

issues.description: The category chip row shows a partially clipped, empty-looking chip after 'Healthy' at the right screen edge, which reads as a rendering artifact.
issues.suggestion: Add a peek/fade gradient at the edge or adjust chip spacing so the cut-off chip clearly signals horizontal scrollability instead of appearing broken.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' card image has a noticeably lighter/washed-out background compared to the darker, richer imagery of neighboring cards, creating visual inconsistency in the carousel.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image treatment (background tone, contrast, or overlay) across carousel cards for a consistent look.
